subject: Request: temporary token allowance while PO clears
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@theragen.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot kickoff + procurement question

Hi Maria —

Great to speak yesterday. Per our conversation, we’re ready to spin up the pilot environment for the medical NLP integration you described. I’ve attached a short SOW draft and a checklist with the baseline configuration we discussed.

I understand procurement is validating the PO; that can sometimes take a few business days. To avoid losing pilot momentum, would TheraGen consider a short-term token allowance from Redwood to keep the environment live while the PO routes?

If that works, I’ll route approval internally and detail the terms (7 days, usage cap, revert to billing once PO clears). If not, we’ll plan a hard start once the PO is finalized. 

Wanted to loop Stephanie on the logistics (she helps with pilot provisioning). Next steps:
- Confirm whether you want us to provision the sandbox now
- If yes, any IP allowlists for the test environment

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: TheraGen-SOW-draft.pdf, pilot-setup-checklist.xlsx

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@theragen.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff + procurement question

Thanks, Karthik —

Appreciate the materials. Procurement did confirm the PO has been created but our finance team put a hold because they need an updated SOC 2 addendum before they can release funds. We’re expediting but expect 4–6 business days.

We really want to keep the pilot active — losing engineers for a week will set back our evaluation. A temporary allowance would be extremely helpful. Two asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood cap usage to the baseline in the checklist to avoid surprise costs?
2) Can we get a short written note confirming the credits are temporary and will be reconciled when the PO clears?

If you can confirm those two pieces, we’ll proceed with allowlist details and a kickoff date.

—Maria Lopez
Director of Engineering, TheraGen Solutions
maria.lopez@theragen.com
+1 617-555-2220

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-06-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Temporary pilot credit ask — TheraGen (DEAL-4581)

Grace / Kimberly —

Heads up: TheraGen (DEAL-4581) is stalled because procurement needs an SOC2 addendum; they expect 4–6 business days. They requested a short-term token allowance to keep the pilot live while the PO completes. Customer asked for two items: a usage cap per our checklist and a written confirmation that credits are temporary and will be reconciled once the PO clears.

Proposal from my side:
- Grant a 7-day token allowance capped at 150k tokens (estimated to cover baseline smoke tests + a few integration runs)
- Require an acknowledgement email from Maria confirming they will finalize the PO within the stated window
- Attach the SOW draft to the HubSpot deal and mark this as a contingent credit so finance can reconcile quickly

Can you advise whether we should:
A) Approve 150k/7-day as a commercial courtesy (no charge until PO clears)
B) Require a credit card on file and auto-bill if PO not cleared by day 7

I’ve attached the SOW draft and the checklist they will follow. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks —
Karthik

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-06-02T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Temporary pilot credit ask — TheraGen (DEAL-4581)

Thanks for the context, Karthik. I’m fine granting a short, tightly-scoped allowance as a sales courtesy to preserve momentum. My guidance:
- Approve option A (150k tokens / 7 days) with two conditions:
  1) We require the customer's procurement point-of-contact to reply-all and confirm expected PO clearance date (Maria asked for written confirmation — this will suffice)
  2) Add a soft cap alert at 80% usage so the customer and our CS team get notified early

Kimberly — can you help create a HubSpot note and flag the credit as contingent so Finance knows to reconcile once the PO lands? Also confirm whether we need a signed addendum before we provision (legal said SOC2 addendum is preferred but not mandatory for pilot in limited scope).

If no objections from Kim / Steph, I’ll mark this approved and Karthik can confirm to the customer.

—Grace
VP, Customer Success

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@theragen.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-06-03T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff + procurement question

Maria —

Good news: we can provision a temporary token allowance to keep your pilot active while the PO completes. Agreed terms below:
- 7 calendar days starting on provisioning date
- 150,000 token allowance total (soft alert at 80%)
- Usage limited to the baseline activities in the attached checklist
- Credits are contingent: Redwood will reconcile once the PO clears; if PO does not arrive by day 7, we’ll discuss next steps with your team (we reserve the right to pause access)

Please reply-all to confirm you accept these terms and that TheraGen expects PO clearance within the 7-day window. Once we have your confirmation, Stephanie will provision the environment and share IP allowlist instructions.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
